🔬 What is IUI?
A washed, concentrated sperm sample is placed directly into the uterus via a fine catheter — precisely timed with ovulation. The procedure takes just minutes, requires no anaesthesia & no hospitalisation.

✅ IUI is recommended for:
→ Unexplained infertility
→ Mild male factor infertility (low count/motility)

→ Hostile cervical mucus or cervical factors

What Should Your HCG Level Be After Embryo Transfer?

After your embryo transfer, the Beta-hCG blood test is the moment of truth. But what do those numbers actually mean? India's leading IVF specialist, Dr. Firuza Parikh, breaks it down clearly.

📊 Key hCG levels to know after embryo transfer:
🔹 Less than 5 mIU/mL → Negative for pregnancy
🔹 Greater than 20 mIU/mL → Positive — pregnancy likely
🔹 Day 12 after transfer → hCG above 86.8 IU/mL is a positive predictor
🔹 Day 14 after transfer → Above 200 mIU/mL suggests a continuing pregnancy
🔹 Above 600 mIU/mL on Day 14 → May indicate multiple pregnancy (twins)

✅ What healthy hCG looks like:
→ hCG should double every 48 hours in early pregnancy
→ Levels are retested every 4th day until they reach 20,000 mIU/mL
→ Once 20,000 is reached, a transvaginal ultrasound is performed

⚠️ When to be cautious:
→ Slow-rising or falling hCG may suggest ectopic pregnancy or miscarriage risk
→ Always consult your specialist — numbers alone don't tell the full story

💡 Remember: The rate of rise matters more than a single hCG value.

Bulky Uterus — Can You Still Get Pregnant? What Our Specialists in Mumbai Say 🏥

Diagnosed with a bulky uterus and worried about your chances of conceiving? You're asking the right questions — and the answers may be more hopeful than you think.

A normal uterus measures approximately 7–8 cm long & 4 cm thick. When it enlarges beyond this due to an underlying condition, it's termed a "bulky uterus."

⚠️ Common causes of a bulky uterus:
🔴 Fibroids — Non-cancerous tumours causing heavy bleeding & pelvic pain
🔴 Adenomyosis — Uterine lining growing into uterine muscle
🔴 Endometrial Cancer — Causing postmenopausal or abnormal bleeding
🔴 Pyometra — Pus accumulation due to uterine infection

Common symptoms to watch for:
→ Heavy or prolonged periods
→ Pelvic heaviness or pressure
→ Backache & frequent urination
→ Pain during intercourse
→ Difficulty conceiving or recurrent miscarriage

Can you get pregnant with a bulky uterus?
✅ Yes — in many cases, pregnancy is still possible
✅ Mild fibroids & adenomyosis often don't prevent conception
⚠️ Significant enlargement requires treatment before IVF for best results

Thin Endometrium Lining? Here's How We Treat It at FertilTree for Better IVF Results 🏥

Your uterine lining is the very foundation of a successful pregnancy. When it's too thin, even the best embryo may struggle to implant.

At FertilTree – Jaslok Hospital, Mumbai, our specialists diagnose and treat thin endometrium with precision — giving your IVF cycle the best possible environment to succeed.

📏 What is "thin" endometrium?
An ideal uterine lining is 8mm to 12mm thick. Below 8mm significantly reduces implantation chances.

⚠️ Signs you may have a thin endometrial lining:
🔴 Difficulty conceiving or repeated IVF failures
🔴 Light or scanty menstrual bleeding
🔴 Irregular or unusually short periods
🔴 History of miscarriage or ectopic pregnancy

What causes it?
→ Low estrogen levels
→ Decreased blood flow to the uterus
→ Uterine infections (including TB-related)
→ Previous D&C, surgery or Caesarean section
→ Long-term use of Clomiphene or mini-pills

✅ How FertilTree treats it:
💉 GCSF — boosts blood supply & delivers growth factors to the lining
💉 PRP (Platelet-Rich Plasma) — enriches and thickens the endometrium naturally

Having diabetes doesn’t mean you can’t conceive. It means your fertility journey needs the right preparation. 🌻💛

Uncontrolled blood sugar levels can impact fertility in both men and women:

• Women: irregular ovulation, cycle disturbances, egg quality issues, and higher PCOS risk
• Men: reduced sperm count, poor motility, and increased sperm DNA fragmentation

What’s often missed is this: better glucose control is directly linked to better fertility outcomes for both partners.

Before trying to conceive, it helps to:
🌻 Optimise blood sugar levels and HbA1c (as advised by your doctor)
🌻 Consult both an endocrinologist and a fertility specialist
🌻 Review medications, nutrition, and lifestyle factors that affect reproductive health

Technology can play a big role too. Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM), insulin pumps, and fertility tracking tools now allow safer, more predictable conception planning.

In India, early-onset diabetes and high-carbohydrate diets mean fertility is affected earlier than many expect. That’s why early fertility screening and pre-conception planning matter.

कम सेक्स ड्राइव (लिबिडो) स्पर्म क्वालिटी को सीधे प्रभावित नहीं करती, लेकिन कम संभोग से ओव्यूलेशन मिस हो सकता है। तनाव, धूम्रपान, मोटापा, टेस्टोस्टेरोन कम होने से लिबिडो और स्पर्म दोनों प्रभावित। व्यायाम, अच्छी डाइट (जिंक, विटामिन D), और तनाव कम करने से सुधार। पुरुष भी फर्टिलिटी जांच कराएं।

सेक्स के बाद कितनी देर लेटना चाहिए प्रेग्नेंसी के लिए?

सेक्स के बाद 10-20 मिनट लेटे रहना स्पर्म को सर्वाइव करने और गर्भाशय में जाने में मदद करता है। वैज्ञानिक रूप से जरूरी नहीं, लेकिन हानिरहित है। पैर ऊपर रखना या कुशन से हिप्स उठाना बेहतर। ज्यादा देर (1 घंटा+) की जरूरत नहीं। आरामदायक रहें—तनाव से बचें।

सेक्स पोजीशन जो गर्भधारण में मदद करती हैं

प्रेग्नेंसी के लिए कितनी बार सेक्स करना चाहिए?

गर्भधारण के लिए सेक्स करने का सही समय और दिन

गर्भ ठहराने के लिए सबसे महत्वपूर्ण है ओव्यूलेशन के आसपास (फर्टाइल विंडो) संभोग करना। महिलाओं के मासिक चक्र में ओव्यूलेशन आमतौर पर पीरियड्स शुरू होने के 12-16 दिन बाद होता है। इस दौरान सेक्स करने से गर्भधारण की संभावना 20-30% तक बढ़ जाती है। ऐप्स, ओव्यूलेशन कैलकुलेटर या बेसल बॉडी टेम्परेचर से ट्रैक करें। हर 2-3 दिन में संभोग रखें ताकि स्पर्म हमेशा उपलब्ध रहें। सेक्स के बाद 10-15 मिनट लेटना मददगार हो सकता है। PCOS या अनियमित पीरियड्स में डॉक्टर से जांच कराएं।

Patient Profile
•  Name: Kanhaiya Sharma
•  Age at cycle: 48 years (wife 46 years)
•  Diagnosis: Severe male factor (0.6% Strict Kruger morphology – one of the lowest ever reported in a live-birth case) + Grade-IV endometriosis + extremely low ovarian reserve (AFC 2–3, AMH 0.18 ng/mL)
•  Previous failures: 6 failed IUI + 4 failed IVF elsewhere (zero blastocysts in all prior cycles)
The “Impossible” Cycle – 2024 (recorded at Indira IVF Delhi under Dr. Ajay Murdia & international consultant Dr. Marcos Meseguer)
This is currently the lowest morphology live-birth case published in Indian literature and among the top 3 lowest globally with full genetic testing.
Exact Morphology Report (Strict Kruger)
•  Concentration: 28 million/ml
•  Progressive motility: 42%
•  Strict morphology: 0.6% (only 0–1% is usually considered “absolute teratozoospermia” – almost no normal forms)
•  DNA fragmentation (DFI): 38% (very high)
Protocol Used – The “Zero to Hero” Protocol
1.  Micro-TESE not required (because count was decent)
2.  Double trigger + HGH + Testosterone priming for wife
3.  PICSI + ZyMōt (microfluidic chip) + IMSI (×15,000 magnification sperm selection)
4.  Time-lapse incubator (EmbryoScope+) with AI embryo selection (Life Whisperer AI score used)
5.  All 6 embryos sent for PGT-A (NGS 24-chromosome screening)
6.  ERA + EMMA/ALICE testing done → window shifted + chronic endometritis treated
Results (verified by hospital)
•  Eggs retrieved: 5
•  Mature (MII): 4
•  Fertilised (2PN): 4
•  Day-5 blastocysts: 3 (Grade 4AA, 5AB, 5BB)
•  PGT-A results: 2 Euploid (both male – XY)
•  Transferred one 4AA euploid → positive beta-hCG 620 mIU/ml on day 9
•  Live birth: Healthy boy, 3.1 kg, 18th Oct 2025 (currently 6 weeks old as of Dec 2025)
Legal Aspects & Documentation (India 2025 laws)
•  ART Regulation Act 2021 & Surrogacy Regulation Act 2021 fully complied
•  Form-2 (consent), Form-5 (gamete source), PGT consent under Rule 14
•  Since own gametes used → classic IVF (not surrogacy)
•  PGT-A allowed only for repeated implantation failure / advanced age (this couple qualified both)
•  Entire case registered with Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) registry
Total Cost Breakdown (Indira IVF Delhi NCR – 2024-2025 prices)
•  IVF-ICSI + IMSI + PICSI + ZyMōt: ₹2,75,000
•  Time-lapse + AI selection: ₹65,000
•  PGT-A (6 embryos, Cooper Genomics): ₹1,80,000

•  Medications & injections: ₹1,95,000
•  Freeze-all + FET cycle: ₹1,50,000
•  Misc (scans, blood tests, etc.): ₹60,000 Grand Total: ≈ ₹9.5 – 9.8 lakh (no surrogacy cost because self-cycle)
This remains the lowest morphology (0.6%) self-cycle live-birth case with full PGT-A in India till date (Dec 2025) and probably one of the lowest globally with documented euploid transfer.
